text: Two elephants once worked in the same circus. Jenny was young. Shirley was older. Then they were split up. *For 22 years* they never saw each other. In 1999, Shirley was sent to an elephant sanctuary in Tennessee. Jenny was already there. The moment they met, they roared and *reached for each other through the bars.* They stayed side by side until Jenny died, seven years later. Like if love remembers.
title: Two Elephants, 22 Years Apart 🐘❤️
pinned: Who would you still recognize after 22 years? 👇
